Array titles

Source: R/titles.R
rray-titles.Rd

Titles are the names on an array's list of names. They appear in array print output.

  • rray_titles() returns the titles for every axis.

  • rray_axis_title() returns the title for one axis.

  • rray_set_titles() sets the titles for every axis.

  • rray_set_axis_title() sets the title for one axis.

Usage

rray_titles(x)

rray_axis_title(x, axis)

rray_set_titles(x, titles)

rray_set_axis_title(x, axis, title)

Arguments

x

An array.

axis

The axis to get or set the title for.

  • For rray_set_axis_title(), given by position or by title.

  • For rray_axis_title(), given by position.

titles

A character vector with one title per axis, or NULL to remove all titles.

title

A single character string, or NULL to remove the title for axis.

Value

  • rray_titles() returns a character vector, or NULL if there are no titles.

  • rray_axis_title() returns one character string, or NULL if there are no titles. It returns "" when the titles vector exists but that axis has no title.

  • The setters return x with new titles. Plain vectors become one-dimensional arrays.

Examples

x <- matrix(1:6, 2, 3)
x <- rray_set_titles(x, c("Row", "Column"))
rray_titles(x)
#> [1] "Row"    "Column"
rray_axis_title(x, 2)
#> [1] "Column"
rray_set_axis_title(x, 1, NULL)
#>       Column
#>        [,1] [,2] [,3]
#>   [1,]    1    3    5
#>   [2,]    2    4    6
rray_set_axis_title(x, "Row", "R")
#>       Column
#> R      [,1] [,2] [,3]
#>   [1,]    1    3    5
#>   [2,]    2    4    6
